whatIs: Icons8 is a bank of icons, illustrations, 3D models, and photos, drawn by a single team in more than 130 icon styles and 330 illustration styles. Because each style is a complete pack, all the pieces of an interface match each other.

Besides searching the website, you can bring them in from Figma, from other editors, or from a coding agent through its MCP server. It also offers AI tools to generate icons and illustrations and to edit photos.
uses: Picking an icon style and using it across an entire app so nothing clashes.
Illustrating empty states, onboarding, or landing page sections with a series in the same style.
Connecting Claude Code or Cursor through MCP so the agent inserts icons while it builds the interface.
caveats: Free use requires putting a link to icons8.com on every page or app where the assets appear.
Without a paid license you don't get access to all formats and sizes.
The AI tools run on credits, which you buy separately or get with the plans.
pricingNote: Free with an attribution link; paid plans remove that requirement and add downloads and AI credits.
idealFor: Teams that want consistent icons and illustrations without drawing them.
